principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class violates the Open/Closed Principle because it requires modification whenever a new shape is added. The current implementation relies on type checks for each shape, making it difficult to extend without modifying existing code.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface or an abstract class named Shape with a method 'area()' that each shape can implement or extend. This way, new shapes can simply provide their own 'area()' method without modifying the AreaCalculator class.

principle_violations.reason: The SumCalculator class is responsible for two different formats of representation (JSON and HTML). This violates the Single Responsibility Principle. Changing the representation format could require changes to this class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create separate formatter classes or methods for JSON and HTML, which handle the representation logic, allowing SumCalculator to focus solely on calculation.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
